Container.Name: immich-machine-learning
Container.Overview: Immich Machine Learning service with NVIDIA CUDA GPU acceleration. Requires an NVIDIA GPU (Pascal generation or newer) with the NVIDIA Container Toolkit installed on the Unraid host. Handles face recognition, CLIP-based image search, and OCR using GPU-accelerated inference. Must be on the same Docker network as the Immich server.
Container.Requires: Requires NVIDIA GPU (Pascal or newer) and NVIDIA Container Toolkit. Must be on the same Docker network as the immich-server container.

Config.Name: Path: Model Cache
Config.Description: ML model cache directory. Models are downloaded on first use (several GB).

Config.Name: MACHINE_LEARNING_MODEL_TTL
Config.Description: Seconds of inactivity before unloading models from VRAM. Set to 0 to keep loaded permanently.

Config.Name: MACHINE_LEARNING_WORKER_TIMEOUT
Config.Description: Seconds before a worker is considered unresponsive. GPU inference can be slow on first run.

Config.Name: IMMICH_LOG_LEVEL
Config.Description: Log verbosity: verbose, debug, log, warn, error
